hero.title: Built by Shoppers, for Shoppers
hero.subtitle: We started with a simple idea: make great products easy to find, easy to trust, and easy to love.

paragraphs.0: It began in a small apartment with three laptops, a spreadsheet of favorite products, and a frustration with clunky online shopping. We wanted a store that felt curated rather than cluttered, fast rather than frustrating, and personal rather than transactional.
paragraphs.1: Today, that same spreadsheet has grown into a full catalog spanning hundreds of products, but the mission hasn't changed: source thoughtfully, ship quickly, and treat every customer like a neighbor, not a number.
paragraphs.2: We're still a small team, but we obsess over the details so your experience feels effortless from browse to doorstep.
